proofs.text: Run `--gate strong` and verify the output contains `.purlin/records/**`, `.purlin/briefs/**` and `force push`; run `--gate passed` and verify it contains `force push` and not `.purlin/records/**`

rule_text: The branch rules the git host has to enforce are printed: under `passed` the force-push and deletion rule alone, and above it the restrictions on `.purlin/records/**` and `.purlin/briefs/**` as well

tests.body:
def test_passed_prints_only_the_force_push_rule(self, project):
        output = project.run('--gate', 'passed')
        assert 'force push' in output.lower()
        assert '.purlin/records/**' not in output
tests.name: test_passed_prints_only_the_force_push_rule

tests.body:
def test_the_branch_rules_are_printed(self, project):
        output = project.run('--gate', 'strong')
        assert '.purlin/records/**' in output
        assert '.purlin/briefs/**' in output
        assert 'force push' in output.lower()
tests.name: test_the_branch_rules_are_printed
